description: This file defines a simple Android activity named SubActivity that extends Activity. It does not provide additional customizations or animations but sets its content view to a layout resource, serving as a part of an application demonstrating window animations.

classes.name: SubActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that inherits from Activity, used within the window animations sample to demonstrate default system animation behavior.
